title: QWOP to St John's
subtitle: Cambridge station to the Great Gate. The Freshers' Guide says it is a 40 minute walk.
controls: Q and W swing the thighs. O and P bend the knees.
start: Press Q, W, O or P to set off
restart: Space, Enter or click to try again

landmarks.name: Cambridge station
landmarks.fact: Trains from London King's Cross and Liverpool Street run about twice an hour each.

landmarks.name: Bus stop
landmarks.fact: Buses 1, 3 and the Park & Ride go from the station to the city centre.

landmarks.name: War memorial
landmarks.fact: A taxi from the station to College is about GBP 10. Just saying.

landmarks.name: Botanic Garden
landmarks.fact: Graduate hostels are spread around Cambridge: older terraces, and bigger newer houses further out.

landmarks.name: Our Lady and the English Martyrs
landmarks.fact: Hostel kitchens are shared and come with no cooking equipment. Bring a pan.

landmarks.name: Parker's Piece
landmarks.fact: Coaches from the airports stop at Parkside, by Parker's Piece. It is a 15 minute walk to College from here.

landmarks.name: Emmanuel College
landmarks.fact: Most rooms have a sink, a bed, a desk, a wardrobe and shelves. Bathrooms are shared.

landmarks.name: Christ's College
landmarks.fact: The U bus is GBP 1 with a University Card and stops 7 minutes from the Northampton Street Porters' Lodge.

landmarks.name: Sidney Sussex
landmarks.fact: From Stansted, the train to Cambridge takes about 35 minutes and costs about GBP 11.

landmarks.name: Round Church
landmarks.fact: Nearly there. The SBR is in First Court: through the Great Gate, staircase I.

landmarks.name: Great Gate
landmarks.fact: Welcome to St John's. The SBR room is at I2, First Court.

facts: The walk from the station to College through the city centre is around 40 minutes.
A taxi from the station to College is about GBP 10.
Buses 1, 3 and the Park & Ride stop in the city centre.
The U bus is GBP 1 with a University Card.
King's Cross trains make fewer stops than Liverpool Street ones, and cost a bit more.
Fast trains from King's Cross are often labelled Ely or King's Lynn. Check the calling points.
Graduate students typically live in College hostels around Cambridge.
Many hostel rooms have wireless internet on the College network.
Most hostels have common rooms, often with a microwave and kettle left by past residents.
The Samuel Butler Room was founded in 1960.
The SBR room is at I2, First Court.
